esp32.detail: 5 pins wired; SEN55 environmental sensor node needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x69. Added the sen55.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM, humidity, temperature, VOC and NOx values set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 5 pins wired; SEN55 environmental sensor node needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. It shares the I2C bus (SDA GP4, SCL GP5) at address 0x69. Added the sen55.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM, humidity, temperature, VOC and NOx values set on the sliders: passes
